---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest an idea or architectural improvement for OpenFaceID
title: '[FEAT] '
labels: ['enhancement']
assignees: ''
---

### Problem Statement
A clear and concise description of what problem this feature solves. (e.g. *I need to be able to...*)

### Proposed Solution
Describe the proposed implementation, new CLI flag, or API extension.

### Alternatives Considered
Describe any alternative designs or workarounds you've evaluated.

### Security & Privacy Impact
Does this change impact camera access, biometric data storage, or network egress?
*(Remember: OpenFaceID maintains a strict zero-cloud-egress and zero-telemetry invariant.)*

### Target Platform(s)
- [ ] macOS
- [ ] Windows
- [ ] Linux
- [ ] All Platforms
